description: Capability of the first-launch window (label `onboarding`, built in src/onboarding_window.rs). Deliberately NOT the main-window capability: the wizard needs to move itself, minimise, close, listen for events and open a vendor's download page in the browser — nothing that spawns a process. The `shell:allow-spawn` entries of default.json exist for external MCP servers, which the wizard never starts; a window that runs before the user has set anything up gets the smallest surface that carries it.
